errors.restore_pending: The account is waiting to be restored. Administrators have received the request.

chat.emptyHint: Ask me to sort mail, find something in your tools or remind you later.
chat.archivedHint: The topic is archived and read-only.

mail.webOnly: The bot was not the only recipient: the answer is only here, not by mail.

chat.imageNotSeen: {model} cannot see images: the agent gets a file in the space

errors.insufficient_balance: The model provider has no balance left. An administrator needs to top it up.
errors.auth: The model connection was rejected. An administrator needs to check its key.
errors.rate_limit: The model is overloaded. Retry in a minute.
errors.unavailable: The model is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.
errors.context_overflow: The conversation became too long for the model. Start a new topic.
errors.agent_busy: The agent is busy. Retry in a minute.
errors.agent_not_configured: The agent is not configured: an administrator has to add a model connection.
errors.user_blocked: Access to the agent is closed for your account.
errors.no_capacity: No free capacity for the agent.
errors.no_models_granted: No model is available to you — ask an administrator.
errors.skill_unavailable: The skill is not available in this conversation — pick it again from the list.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.hint: Tasks are created in the conversation with the agent: ask it to remind you once or to do something regularly.
tasks.example: “Every Monday at 10:00 send me a metrics summary in Telegram”
tasks.emptyHint: Ask your agent in the chat to create one.
tasks.cancelText: The task «{title}» will not run any more.
tasks.channelUnavailable: channel unavailable, delivered to the web

memory.title: Memory
memory.lead: What your agent remembers about you. It saves facts in conversations; you can edit, delete or add records.
memory.clearText: All records will be deleted. The agent will stop using them from the next message.
memory.emptyHint: Tell the agent what to remember, or add a record.

space.title: Space
space.lead: The personal workspace of your agent: files persist between conversations and are isolated from other users.
space.emptyHint: Files the agent creates and files you upload appear here.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lead: Messengers for talking to your agent and the tools of the company it may use.
connections.tokenHint: The token is stored encrypted in Nabu, never in the agent's space.
connections.channelUnavailable: The channel is not available for your account.
connections.keyHint: Get a personal key and send it to the bot {bot} once.
connections.keyText: Send this key to {bot} as the first message.
connections.keyOnce: Copy the key now: it is shown only once. To see a key again, reissue it.
connections.emailHint: Write to the bot from your corporate address. The bot answers by mail only when it is the only recipient; otherwise the answer waits in Nabu.
connections.vkteamsHint: Add the bot to your contacts or write to it first: it finds you by the email of your account.

admin.title: Administration
admin.noAccess: The platform administrator role is required

users.title: Users
users.inviteHint: The user gets the role at the first sign-in.
users.newIdentity: A new ID at the sign-in provider: {subject}. Restoring links it to the archived account.
users.sameIdentity: The same ID at the sign-in provider.
users.archiveHint: Sign-in and all channels are closed, tasks are paused, the sandbox, personal accesses and the Telegram link are removed. Conversations, memory and files are kept until the retention ends.

models.title: Model connections
models.lead: Direct connections to providers or to an OpenAI-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM.
models.name: Name
models.editModelsHint: A removed model is no longer offered to users; agents and settings that use it must be reconfigured.
models.personalHint: The default model of personal agents and the models users may choose.
models.noList: The provider does not list models. Known models of this type are shown.
models.newHint: New models of the provider are not added by themselves: the card of the connection marks them «new».
models.availableByGroups: The models users may choose are granted to groups.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.name: Name

modeHint.personal: Users grant access on their own behalf; the agent acts with their rights.
modeHint.platform: A service credential of the platform; read-only unless switched off.

catalog.delegationHint: Nabu signs a token for this audience and passes the user's email; the product checks the signature by Nabu's keys.
catalog.toolsOf: {allowed} of {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}}
catalog.toolsHint: The agent sees only the checked tools. New tools of the server stay off until you check them.
catalog.fileArgHint: The agent passes a path in its space; the server gets a temporary link to a copy of the file.
catalog.checkFirst: Save and check the item to choose its tools
catalog.checkNeedsConnection: Connect the item in Connections to check it: the server answers only with a personal access.

service-agents.title: Service agents
service-agents.lead: Preconfigured executors of background tasks that services call through the API.
service-agents.name: Name
service-agents.mcpHint: Platform MCP servers only; callers can pass their own servers for one run.
service-agents.callerMcp: Accept MCP servers of the caller

clients.title: Service clients
clients.auditHint: Actions on behalf of users are written to the audit with the client.
clients.secretOnce: Copy the secret now: it is shown only once.
clients.name: Name
clients.deleteText: Its credentials stop working at once. A client that has runs cannot be deleted, so that the history keeps its name: disable it instead.

channels.title: Channels
channels.lead: Where users talk to their agents and who has access to each channel.
channels.domainsHint: Letters are accepted only from these domains.
channels.authservHint: The server name in the Authentication-Results header of the provider; filled by the provider.
channels.secretSet: Set. Enter a new value to replace it
channels.secretHint: The secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
channels.rules: The bot answers by mail only when it is the only recipient: one address in To and an empty Cc. Other letters are answered in the topic of the web application. Actions that change data wait for the confirmation of the user.

group-agents.title: Group agents
group-agents.lead: Agents of group chats with their own memory and space and platform access only.
group-agents.transferHint: The new owner is an administrator or a member of the group with access to the channel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.retentionHint: After this time an archived account and its data are deleted for good. The same time is kept for the data of a group agent removed from its group.
settings.confirmText: The new retention of {days} days applies to all archived accounts.
settings.willPurge: {count, plural, =0 {No account is deleted by the next purge.} one {The next purge deletes # account.} other {The next purge deletes # accounts.}}
settings.voiceHint: The stand option NABU_WHISPER deploys the recognizer.

agent-pods.title: Agents
agent-pods.lead: Every user and every group agent runs in a pod of its own. A stopped pod loses nothing: the conversation continues from the last answer.
agent-pods.local: Agents run in the shared operator: pods of owners are off in this installation.
agent-pods.emptyHint: A pod starts with the first message of a user.
agent-pods.stopText: The agent is answering the user now. The turn will be interrupted: the user will see an error and can send the message again. The conversation stays.
agent-pods.fullQueue: {count, plural, one {# message waits} other {# messages wait}} in the queue, the oldest for {time}.

fullSources.config: The ceiling of {max} pods comes from the settings (AGENT_PODS_MAX).
fullSources.quota: The ceiling of {max} pods comes from the quota of the namespace.
fullSources.cluster: The ceiling of {max} pods comes from the cluster: a new pod could not be placed at {when}.

agent-pods.fullAdvice: To serve more users, add nodes or lower the resource requests of a pod.

comm.title: Memory of communications
comm.lead: Users switch the collection of their mail and messengers on themselves, after their consent.
comm.retentionHint: Counted from the last message. A note with an open commitment is kept until the commitment is closed.
comm.modelMissing: Without a model the collection does not run.
comm.limitHint: When it is spent the collection pauses until next month; digests keep working. 0 — no limit.
comm.sourcesHint: A personal MCP server becomes a source when an adapter exists for it.
comm.noContent: The content of notes is not available to the administrator.
comm.embeddings: Model of the search by meaning
comm.embeddingsHint: An embeddings model of a connection. After a change the vectors are recounted in the background.
comm.wordsOnly: The search works by words only: choose an embeddings model.
comm.noVectors: The database has no vector extension: the search works by words only.

groups.title: Groups
groups.adminsHint: Members are the users with the administrator role
groups.adminsAll: Administrators have everything enabled on the platform
groups.priority: The default model comes from the group higher in the list. A user has everything granted to their groups.
groups.onlyBuiltin: Create a group to grant resources to some of the users
groups.name: Name
groups.channelOff: The channel is off in the instance
groups.deleteText: Delete the group “{name}”? {count} members lose the access it grants.
groups.mcpRevoke: {count} members lose access to “{item}”. Their connections are deleted — they will have to connect again.
groups.addMember: Find a user by name or email
groups.unsavedText: The changes of the group are not saved. Leave without saving?

access.title: Access
access.noModels: No model is available to the user: the agent will not answer

defaultFrom.group: the default model of the group {group}

comm.lead: What the agent knows about you and your work correspondence
comm.emptyHint: Notes appear after the next collection.

invite.title: Your work correspondence will appear here

note.title: Title
note.editHint: After your edit the collector no longer rewrites the text: news are added below as a separate block.
note.deleteText: The note and its commitments are deleted. This thread will not be collected again.

wizard.title: Switch the collection of communications on

read.title: What is read.
read.text: Your incoming and sent letters and the chats where you wrote or were mentioned.

stored.title: What is stored.
stored.text: A summary, the participants, the topics and links to the messages. The text of messages is not stored.

seen.title: Who sees it.
seen.text: Only you and your agent. The administrator does not see the content.

remove.title: How to delete.
remove.text: Any note or everything collected — in Memory, at any time.

wizard.agree: I understand that Nabu will read my work correspondence, and I agree
wizard.history: When switched on, the correspondence of the last 30 days is collected.
wizard.digestHint: The channel and the time of digests can be changed afterwards.

tasks.hint: Switched-on tasks appear in the Tasks section marked Memory. They do not count towards the limit of active tasks.

collect.title: Communications collection
collect.text: Reads new letters and messages, saves notes and commitments.
collect.noSource: Connect a source of communications first.

day.title: Daily digest

week.title: Weekly digest

exclusionHint.folders: The id of a label or a folder

tasks.neverCollected: Mailings and automatic letters are never collected.
